default.why: Stage + Questions scores 88/100: its opening tab alone answers pass/fail, which run is worst and when (scorecard, worst-joint and tool error against shaded tolerance bands, events), and the 3D stage and camera overlay never leave the screen while you work through where, which joint, and timing-or-shape. Its one weak spot is drill-down into a single run (no per-run page).
default.hinge: Drill-down weight. Run Tabs (77) wins once 'open one run on its own' matters more than layout stability: move 10 points from 'A stock default' to 'Drill into one run' and Run Tabs edges ahead, 83 to 82. The splice that removes the hinge: Stage + Questions with Run Tabs' 'All runs' overview as its first tab and per-run pages under a Runs tab.

fr1.evidence: Opening tab shows the target path coloured by the worst run's error, the tool error with its tolerance band and RMS bars per run; no verdict text, and the bars carry only numeric x labels.

fr2.evidence: No per-run page; isolating a run means toggling legend entries.

fr3.evidence: Joint error and along/across (contour, lag time) tabs are each one click, zoom-linked, with bands — but on separate full-screen tabs, so joint and timing never sit side by side.

fr4.evidence: Video lives on its own tab; no plot is visible while the video plays.

fr5.evidence: Seven fixed tabs; joints grow inside one grid, runs inside legends; a missing video just empties one tab.

g1.evidence: v1-evo-tabs.rrd opens in stock 0.40.0 with the layout embedded (screenshots are that viewer).

g2.evidence: Joint panels are /deg/…, tool in mm, rotation in °; the SI rad channels are not shown.

fr1.evidence: Opening tab: scorecard sorted worst first (Real #4, 10.96 mm), worst-joint and tool error against shaded bands, events log; stage and overlay beside.

fr2.evidence: Runs are only legend entries; no per-run page, and the stage overlays every run at once.

fr3.evidence: Where? (belt frame), Which joint? (6 × ° with bands), Timing or shape? (lag time vs contour) — each a question-named tab, zoom-linked.

fr4.evidence: 3D stage over the camera overlay stays on the left for every tab, on the same playhead.

fr5.evidence: Five fixed tabs; joints grow in 2-column grids; runs grow the scorecard and legends, not the tab bar.

g2.evidence: All joint views in ° and °/s, tool in mm, torque in N·m.

fr1.evidence: 'All runs' opens on the worst-first scorecard, RMS bars, every run's error and the target path coloured by the worst run's error — where on the path it peaks.

fr3.evidence: Per-run joint errors with bands, but no lag/contour/along-across view anywhere.

fr4.evidence: Run tabs hold 3D + camera + errors together; the opening overview has no video or robot.

fr5.evidence: The tab bar grows with the run count: 7 tabs here, unreadable at 20 repeats.

g2.evidence: Joint errors in °, tool in mm.

fr1.evidence: Opens on the shoulder pan tab: one joint's signals; no verdict, no worst run, no where-on-path.

fr2.evidence: No per-run page; legend toggles only.

fr5.evidence: Tab count = joints + 1: fine for 2–7 DOF, but a long tab bar for a 12-DOF system.
